name: Olive Branch

yarn.description: Cotton or cotton-blend yarn for branch and leaves

additional_materials: 22 cm length of 24-gauge green floral wire
gauge: Gauge is not critical. Match the stated size by keeping the foundation chain close to 20 cm long before wiring.

steps.label: Leaf row
steps.text: Leave a 20 cm beginning tail, then ch 53. In the 2nd ch from hook, make a leaf: ch 8; sl st in 2nd ch from hook, sc in next ch, hdc in each of next 2 ch, dc in each of next 2 ch, hdc in last ch; sl st in the same foundation ch. Sl st in each of the next 3 foundation ch. Repeat the leaf and 3 sl st sequence 12 more times, making 13 leaves total.

finishing: Fasten off, leaving a 20 cm tail at the final stem end.
Use wire cutters to trim the floral wire to 22 cm. Fold back 5 mm at each wire end to make smooth, blunt tips.
Lay the crocheted foundation chain along the wire. Use the beginning and final tails to secure the chain to the wire with small whipstitches at both ends.
Weave the remaining yarn tails through the back of the chain and trim them close.
Gently curve the wired stem. Twist alternate leaves slightly to opposite sides of the stem for an airy olive-branch shape.
notes: Keep the leaf chains relaxed so the leaves remain narrow and pointed.
The floral wire is hidden behind the foundation chain and allows the branch to be posed in a bouquet or vase.
